title: Discussion sentence stems
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 89 (Discussion sentence stems (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 89: If our clock struck thirteen: past or future? (talk for writing). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Discussion rules
points: One voice at a time (mics off until chosen)

parts.text: View: I would choose the past
Reason 1: to thank my grandmother again
Reason 2: to see my town before the new buildings
Build: the future is unknown, and I want to trust Allah's plan

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: I would choose the past, because I could thank my grandmother again and see how my town looked.

keywords.def: a talk where people share and build on ideas

questions.q: Say your view in one sentence with because
questions.a: For example: I'd choose the future because I want to see what job I do.

questions.q: Core: in a breakout room, discuss past or future using the stems; note three ideas
questions.a: Three noted ideas from the discussion

questions.q: Extend: write a paragraph justifying your choice with two reasons
Stretch: write how you would feel meeting yourself
questions.a: For example: strange, nervous and curious all at once

questions.q: Which response builds on 'I'd visit my past to see my grandparents'?
options: Adding to that, you could ask them stories about their childhood.
questions.a: B) Adding to that, you could ask them stories about their childhood.. It adds a new idea to the first speaker's point.
